$description: KitchenKin Design System — DTCG token source. Edit values here only; run `pnpm tokens` in kkds-common (or kkds-web) to regenerate. Colors are hex; the generator converts them to HSL channels for the shadcn theme and keeps hex for mobile consumers. Every color role appears in both light and dark.

primary.$description: KitchenKin coral-orange. Used for primary buttons, links, and emphasis.

primaryForeground.$description: Dark warm brown on primary fills — meets WCAG AA (≥4.5:1) with coral primary.

secondary.$description: Warm amber-orange. Supporting actions and secondary emphasis.

secondaryForeground.$description: Dark warm brown on secondary fills — meets WCAG AA with amber secondary.

mutedForeground.$description: Muted warm brown body/caption text — meets WCAG AA on cream backgrounds.

accent.$description: Deeper orange accent. Hover states and tonal highlights.

accentForeground.$description: Dark warm brown on accent fills — meets WCAG AA with accent orange.

ring.$description: Warm focus ring — meets ≥3:1 non-text contrast on cream backgrounds.

background.$description: Very dark warm brown surface — warm-toned, not cold gray.

primary.$description: Coral-orange, slightly brightened for dark backgrounds.

sans.$description: KitchenKin primary display and UI sans-serif (Quicksand via Google Fonts).

serif.$description: Serif for editorial and recipe contexts.

mono.$description: Monospace stack for code and measurement labels.

base.$description: Base corner radius (10px). Matches the web app's --radius: 0.625rem. sm/md/lg/xl derive from this.
Base spacing step the shadcn components multiply.

motion.$description: Semantic motion tokens. Duration values are CSS time strings; easing values are CSS cubic-bezier strings. Platform-neutral — web maps these to Framer Motion or CSS transitions; mobile maps them to Reanimated or React Native Animated equivalents.

instant.$description: Imperceptible. Micro-state changes such as icon swaps or badge count updates.

fast.$description: Quick user feedback — button press, checkbox toggle, switch flip.

normal.$description: Standard UI transitions — most state changes.

slow.$description: Deliberate entries — panel slides, modal reveals.

deliberate.$description: Slow, intentional — skeleton-to-content swaps, page-level transitions.

skeleton.$description: Loading pulse cycle — long enough to feel calm, not anxious.

standard.$description: Balanced curve. Use for most UI transitions.

enter.$description: Decelerate into position — elements arriving in the viewport.

exit.$description: Accelerate out — elements leaving the viewport.

spring.$description: Slight overshoot for playful, tactile feedback.
